modifications: Added an exact source-bound admission profile for two cold Qwen3-0.6B HTTP requests at 63/65 prompt tokens and two greedy response tokens. A declared cohort attaches two queued jobs to one shared native arena, while the ready step requires 28 terminal two-span reads, 28 grouped writes, 28 tile dispatches, and zero direct writes. Receipts distinguish selected, observed-used, and unqualified states and preserve output token IDs. Missing partners and unsupported shapes fail closed. A separate v2 admission profile accepts distinct cold prompt lengths 32-127 with two explicit greedy output tokens, while retaining all physical grouped/tile/read and retirement gates. At temperature zero the ordinary sampler does not apply top-p/top-k/min-p transforms, so v2 admits model-default values of those fields. V1 remains bound to 63/65 and neutral filters.
validation: Source 463aa561 passed one source-bound two-request loopback HTTP gate under GPUQ: native and ordinary IDs both [[14582,198],[14582,14582]], 28 grouped and tile dispatches, zero direct writes, 28 two-span reads, 84 matched terminals, zero pending epochs/pages, and fully retired owners; raw receipt SHA-256 de0888b433b5f69d452495a171377f91a61fa14d20887c701d26316583369601 in qualification/runs/varlen-b2-http-463aa561-passed. The harness used candidate service mode, so top-level unqualified-mode confirmation remains. The earlier six-cell 27811f59 diagnostic is a mechanism screen, price_usable=false, and does not qualify or measure this new serving route. Warm B2 APCv2 restore and genuine Metal failure remain unverified. Existing B1 APCv2 warm restore is unchanged. Sequential lane publication is fail-contained but not cross-lane atomic rollback. Source df9a16f1 also passed one ordinary unqualified service-mode 63/65 gate: both top-level HTTP statuses unqualified, exact native/ordinary IDs, 28 grouped/28 tile/0 direct dispatches, 84 terminals, zero pending/retained, raw receipt SHA-256 c3291b7ed63db394c6b9fe1919816756f37ef4a6badba48c2f622381183627ae. V2 has CPU boundary/lifecycle tests but no live GPU qualification yet. Source afbb10b1 passed one bounded dynamic v2 32/127 HTTP functional gate in unqualified mode: exact native/ordinary IDs [[14582,198],[14582,14582]], matched effective sampler fields including default top_p 0.8/top_k 20 at temperature zero, 28 grouped/28 tile/0 direct, 28 two-span reads, 84 terminals, zero pending/retained and fully retired owners. Raw receipt SHA-256 522292d692aa83ecb52f5caa0f1e6d225a9e48539479d1bb2156070818927078 in qualification/runs/varlen-b2-http-afbb10b1-dynamic; GPUQ rc0, swapouts0, locks restored. These are host timings and do not isolate GPU kernel time. Keep unqualified/default-off/price_usable=false.
